title: Decontam index lacks JevBench/typed-decisions; no 13-gram or option-set test
detail: The only decontamination code in the repo indexes evals/**/*.jsonl utterances plus HobbyLM frozen TSVs, and matches with char-5/bigram/8-gram Jaccard. It never loads JevBench public (231) or the typed-decisions test, never looks at states/criteria/descriptions, and has no option-set check. If the decisions run reuses it (the obvious path, multi-task with route data), the reported contamination count is 0 by construction for the two benchmarks we publish.
evidence: decontam.py:49-63 eval_utterances() globs REPO/evals/**/*.jsonl and HOBBY=/data/evals/hobbylm/data/frozen only; Feats (37-46) holds text-only features; match() 78-90 has no 13-gram path. My own mandated index (jevbench@609a664 + td@80cb93a + route_v1 + live_t1 + external) = {external:570, td/test:400, route_v1:140, jev/hard:111, jev/original:72, jev/easy:48, live_t1:43}; decontam.py covers only the last 3.
fix: New decontam for decisions: load jevbench datasets/public/{easy,original,hard}.jsonl@609a664 and td all/test parquet@80cb93a; per item concatenate state_text(state)+instructions+criteria/descriptions; drop on ANY shared word 13-gram (containment, not Jaccard) plus option-set rule (see decisions-2); write counts per source to the run report.

title: Identical-option-set rule is degenerate on benchmark option sets
detail: typed-decisions reuses a handful of generic option sets across 2000 decisions and 200 noul have no criteria at all (default true/false); score options are '0'..'n-1'. A key-only comparison flags every synthetic noul/score item (so it will be quietly loosened or skipped); a text comparison of route items flags all route datums because route_v1 uses the same 41-option catalog. Either way the 'counts must be 0' report is meaningless unless the rule is pinned down.
evidence: Independent count: td test 2000 decisions -> 16 distinct normalized option-set signatures (600 choice/600 noul/800 score); td noul 400 with criteria, 200 without; JevBench 109 distinct sets, all 74 noul use criteria {false,true}; 0 signature overlap between JevBench and td.
fix: Define: choice -> drop if (sorted option keys, normalized descriptions) equals a benchmark set; noul -> compare criteria texts only when present; score -> compare level description texts; exempt route datums vs route_v1 option catalog explicitly (utterance checks still apply) and report exempt counts separately.

title: Route regression would be measured with the wrong renderer and n=140
detail: Brief runs route_v1 through the new Tinker-sampler Decider for bench/systemone, i.e. GenericRenderer (_decision: stock system prompt, 'State/Question' user text, choices in user turn). Route datums are trained and served with RouteDecisionRenderer (route system prompt with choices in system, 'Context: app=... | ...' user line). Measuring the multi-task adapter on a prompt it was never trained on for routing gives a spurious drop (or hides a real one). Also 1 point on 140 items = 1.4 items; SE at top-1 0.918 is sqrt(.918*.082/140)=2.3 pts, so a 1-point gate is noise.
evidence: Tokenizer check (Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B, transformers 5.5.4): GenericRenderer static prefix = 42 tokens decoding to 'Answer the user's question by picking exactly one of the choices they supply...'; training route_render.py:29-35,106-131 renders ROUTE_SYSTEM with choices + ROUTE_USER. eval_route.py:27-60 already evaluates route_v1/val via render_route.
fix: Score route regression with training/src/muselet_train/eval_route.py (--set route_v1 and --set val) for both the route-only and the multi-task checkpoint; report paired per-item deltas (McNemar) on val, not only route_v1.

title: noul option order flips with criteria presence: position-shortcut risk
detail: With criteria {false,true} the order follows criteria keys (JevBench: false=choice#A); without criteria it is [true='Yes', false='No'] (true=choice#A). td test has 200/600 noul without criteria. Synthetic data generated 'with criteria' only (brief line 45) never trains the default form, and if gold is skewed by form the model learns 'A' instead of the question. Also a Tinker Decider re-implementing this order would silently break parity.
evidence: generic_decide.py:27-30 quoted; JevBench public noul 74/74 have criteria (false first); td noul 400 crit / 200 no-crit.
fix: Generate >=1/3 noul without criteria; balance gold over choice#A/B within each form; report gold-position histogram per type and option count; have the Tinker Decider import _decision/_choices rather than copy them.

title: Before/after benchmark numbers would mix MLX-4bit and Tinker-bf16
detail: Baseline row is MLX base Qwen3.5-4B-4bit vs DeskMind 8-bit; the planned 'after' numbers come from the Tinker sampler (bf16 base + LoRA). A before/after delta across precision/runtime is not attributable to training, and 4-bit vs 8-bit is not tuned-vs-tuned (standing decision). Publishing it as 'Muselet vs DeskMind' would be a wrong-result-presented-as-correct risk.
evidence: builder_decisions.md:15 'Muselet = base Qwen3.5-4B-4bit, zero-shot 0.719 ... 0.569'; :16 'DeskMind brain-4b G18b (8-bit) 0.831 ... 0.658'; :60 'Add a Tinker-sampler-backed Decider'. No claims found yet in pitch/docs/README on main 1ce501b, wip/local 38768f3, cloud/pitch ad1b058.
fix: Report cloud numbers as 'Tinker bf16' and compute before/after on the same backend (base through the same Tinker Decider); headline claim only from the fused adapter on MLX with quantization recorded, plus Muselet 8-bit to match DeskMind; label zero-shot vs fitted-on-train per row.

title: No token parity reference exists for the generic decision path
detail: The only parity reference is route-only; the cloud/bench test only asserts static prefix, choice_pos and single-token labels, never equality with a training renderer. Generic tokens depend on state_text (json.dumps default separators, sort_keys=False, ensure_ascii=False) and schema normalization (list criteria, score levels '0'..'n-1'); a data builder that pretty-prints JSON or sorts keys changes every training token with no test failing.
evidence: bench/tests/test_systemone.py:360-400@2c57d7f assertions quoted (static prefix, choice_pos, label_tokens); server.py:20-21 state_text; training/artifacts lists only gen_sample2_picked, parity_300, route_render_samples.
fix: Commit training/artifacts/decision_render_samples.jsonl (incl. a JevBench-hard-length dict state, a td no-criteria noul, a score and a >58-option chunked case) and a test asserting builder tokens == GenericRenderer.render_decisions(prepare(state_text(parse_request(...)))) tokens.

title: A 20k-decision multi-task run likely exceeds the $25 gate
detail: Each typed question is a separate datum that repeats the full state, so cost scales with state length; hard-split-like states are ~8x td states. Plan the estimate before generating 25k items.
evidence: Measured rendered tokens/question: JevBench easy 158, original 164, hard 1265 (max 3987); td 250; route datum 931 (parity_300). Rate from phase1_main: $29.45/37.59M = $0.78/M. 20k decisions at 1/3 hard-length (avg ~590) = 11.8M + 30% route replay 8.6k x 931 = 8.0M -> 19.8M/epoch = $15.5; 2 epochs = $31 > $25. Headroom: $150-37-32 = $81.
fix: Cap hard-length states at ~1/4 of items or 1 epoch, or batch several questions per state into one datum only if inference renders the same; post estimate and get lead OK before launch.

title: Benchmark test rows committed as examples; keep out of teacher prompts
detail: bench/systemone/examples holds verbatim JevBench public rows (easy/original/hard) and typed-decisions test rows. If the synthetic generator uses them as format few-shots, teachers produce paraphrases that 13-gram matching does not catch.
evidence: README lists jevbench/hard.json = hard-opus-a-temporal_numeric-12, typed_decisions/test-1..3.json = agent_trace_observability_000000..2 from all/test parquet. Independent sample check: training/artifacts/parity_300.jsonl 0 exact/13-gram hits; gen_sample2_picked.jsonl 3 exact hits vs external ('open reminders','open documents','take a screenshot') -- generation sample, final route_train not on branch so survival unverified.
fix: Generator must not read bench/systemone/examples, jevbench/ or td/; use hand-written seeds; add an assertion in the generator that no seed shares a 13-gram with these files.

title: it2 terse-ASK top-up targets route_v1 ASK items; decontam misses swaps
detail: IT2_ASK_STYLE asks teachers for 2-4-word ASK requests pointing at 'it', 'him', 'the one from earlier' — wording lifted from route_v1's ASK items — and H2 is confirmed on 'route_v1 ASK >= 6/8'. route_v1 is a mandated decontam set and the route-regression gate for the decisions run; tuning data to its 8 ASK items makes that gate optimistic. decontam.py drops exact/char-5 matches but one-word swaps of these short items pass, so near-copies will reach training.
evidence: gen.py:153 IT2_ASK_STYLE '...like 'it', 'him', 'the one from earlier''; route_v1 ASK = start a countdown | shoot him a text | open the one from earlier | put it in there | set the volume | remind me | email her | schedule something. decontam.Index@70b7d1b on those 8: 'shoot her a text' -> None, 'email him' -> None, 'text her' -> None, 'set volume' -> None, 'remind me later' -> None, 'start a timer' -> None ('open the one from before' -> char5 dropped).
fix: Drop the route_v1 phrases from IT2_ASK_STYLE; judge H2 on val ASK only (report route_v1 ASK as secondary, flagged as tuned-on); for items <= 5 tokens also drop if token-set differs by one word from any eval item (e.g. Levenshtein on tokens <= 1).

title: it2 retrain plan has hypotheses but no token/$ estimate
detail: Lane rule: every Tinker run posts hypotheses AND a token/$ estimate first; >$25 needs the lead's OK. The it2 plan is a fresh run at main's settings on a superset of main's data, so it costs at least main's $29.45 — over the gate — and leaves about $51 of the $150 cap for the decisions run.
evidence: plan:3 'Fresh run, same settings as main ... 1 epoch'; data = full1 + v2new + it2 top-ups + all ask2; phase1_main.md:24,33 max_usd 35.0, est_usd 29.45 (37.59M train tokens). 150 - 37 spent - 32 committed - ~29.5 it2 = ~$51. Cumulative guard gap already tracked as training-5. gen.py:136 marks only the API top-ups 'lead-approved'.
fix: Add 'est train tokens / est_usd / --max-usd' to phase1_it2_plan.md (dry-run train.py pre-flight) and record the lead's OK for >$25; set --max-usd to min(35, 150 - billed - committed - decisions reserve).

title: DeskMind baseline numbers disagree across docs; scorer now non-upstream
detail: RUNBOOK lists DeskMind JevBench hard as 'not reported' while the decisions brief compares against 0.676; the 0.658 typed-decisions number predates the new normalize_answer path, which is not in the upstream scorer (score -> one-hot, noul -> {1-p,p}). Any 'beat DeskMind' claim from these rows is not reproducible from one runner.
evidence: RUNBOOK.md:129 '| DeskMind brain-4b | 0.831 | not reported | 0.658 |'; builder_decisions.md:16@bb494af 'DeskMind ... 0.831 | 1.000 / 0.958 / 0.676 | 0.658'; typed_decisions.py normalize_answer added in f584cb2; RUNBOOK:134 'rerun brain-4b to get the disclosed counts'.
fix: Rerun brain-4b on JevBench (per-tier) and typed-decisions with f584cb2, publish normalized_answers counts next to the number, and make the brief table cite runs/bench/<run>/summary.json paths.

title: cloud/decisions forked pre-f584cb2; merge drops scorer, venv and split_model fixes
detail: cloud/decisions merged cloud/bench at 2c57d7f, so it lacks f584cb2 (typed_decisions normalize_answer, run_jevbench ml venv) and main's split_model untied-head fix. A merge into main 2920225 conflicts in decision.py, run_jevbench.sh, RUNBOOK.md and the harness; resolving to the branch side silently reverts DeskMind noul/score normalization (those answers then score as empty distributions) and the language_model.lm_head lookup (untied VLM wrappers fall back to tied embeddings -> wrong logits).
evidence: git merge-tree 1ce501b origin/main origin/cloud/decisions -> conflict markers in ml/src/brain/decision.py, bench/run_jevbench.sh (PY= venv block), bench/RUNBOOK.md (Mac results); grep -c normalize_answer bench/typed_decisions.py@3a865a0 = 0; grep language_model decision.py@3a865a0 = none vs decision.py:203@2920225; merge-base(cloud/bench, cloud/decisions) = 2c57d7f.
fix: Rebase cloud/decisions on main 2920225 before review/merge; keep main's split_model (ml/tests/test_split_model.py must pass) and f584cb2 typed_decisions/run_jevbench; only add tinker_backend.py, choice_renderer.py move and cli --backend tinker.
